note: Hammer blueprints. Dave 4 Nov 2026: no kits at all; everything placed is built with the hammer from the materials in the pack, except the Rough bed (a hand craft from the pack; blueprint 24 retired) and the campfire (a fire entity; code pending). 'structure' is a structures.json kind, 'cost' [item, count] is taken all or nothing (the retired kit recipe's ingredients), 'station' empty or a placed station that must be near (with 'station_level'), 'near' another placed structure that must be near, 'hammer' the minimum tier of the hammer on the hotbar (1 wooden, 2 stone; default 1), 'recipe' the retired kit recipe (kept so its number is never reused, and so learning that recipe can unlock the row), 'known' false rows are learned, 'retired' rows are kept for their numbers and are not offered or placed. Taking the piece down gives the cost back. Ids are the blueprint's own, append only.

stone_forge.name: Primitive smithy
stone_forge.note_provisional: PROVISIONAL (GOALS-REPAIR A-8): 2 Log in place of the old 2 Hide, so the Primitive smithy is built from stone, clay and wood only (master s2.7 item 2, repair plan P3). Build costs of the seven stations are open (master s3.3).

blacksmithy.name: Improved smithy
blacksmithy.note_provisional: PROVISIONAL (GOALS-REPAIR A-15): the Improved smithy is built with bronze fittings and a bronze anvil (6 Bronze ingots), no iron (master s2.7 item 5, s3.3), so iron is not needed before the station that first works it.

advanced_smithy.name: Advanced smithy
advanced_smithy.note_provisional: PROVISIONAL (GOALS-REPAIR A-20): built with the Iron anvil forged at the Improved smithy (master s2.7 item 6, plan P3), with iron nails and hinges from the same smithy; no steel. Build costs of the seven stations are open (master s3.3).

improved_smelter.name: Improved smelter
improved_smelter.note_provisional: PROVISIONAL (GOALS-REPAIR A-9): the Primitive smelter's 24 Clay and 10 Stone grown to 16 Stone, 2 Log and 3 Hide for the hand bellows, and the bronze fittings master s2.7 item 4 names (2 Bronze hinges, 20 Bronze nails, from the Primitive smithy). No iron, Planks or Nails. Build costs of the seven stations are open (master s3.3).

large_forge.name: Advanced smelter
large_forge.note_cost: GOALS-REPAIR R4: the Blast furnace's cost carried over unchanged for the Advanced smelter, its windmill and two bellows built in (master s3.3 leaves build costs open); no steel, so steel is not needed before the station that first makes it.

master_forge.name: Master smithy
master_forge.note_cost: GOALS-REPAIR R5 (CATALOG_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN R5: built with the Steel anvil; master s2.7 item 9): the old cost with the Steel anvil (forged at the Advanced smithy from 5 Steel ingots) in place of its 4 Steel ingots; the rest of the cost is unchanged (master s3.3 leaves build costs open).

bellows.name: Bellows
bellows.note_known: GOALS-REPAIR R3 (CATALOG_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN s1: the standalone Smithy Bellows must not return; master s2.7 item 4: the Improved smelter's bellows are its own): not buildable (known false), kept so a placed Bellows still takes down into these materials.

quenching_trough.name: Quenching trough
quenching_trough.note_known: GOALS-REPAIR R5 (CATALOG_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN s1: the standalone Smithy Quenching trough must not return; master s2.7 item 9: the Master smithy's quencher is built in): not buildable (known false), kept so a placed Quenching trough still takes down into these materials.
